summary: v135.39 testing (iteration 52). BLOCKER FOUND & UNBLOCKED: /app/frontend/src/pages/Events.jsx had TemplateQuickPickButton pasted in the middle of a JSX <input> attribute list inside BireyselEventForm -> Babel SyntaxError at 3403:32, whole frontend failed to compile (CRA overlay 'Compiled with problems', every page dead). I moved the component to module scope (end of file) so the app compiles, then ran full testing. Backend: 27 new pytest cases (test-send, rsvp-schedules CRUD, scheduler fire loop) + 24 iteration_51/50 regression cases -> 50 passed / 1 failed. Frontend: '/' focus shortcut on all 3 tabs (no hijack while typing), Ctrl+Enter submit on all 3 composer modals, Test Gönder (warning toast, no push/telegram in env), Zamanla schedule create/list/delete, /etkinlikler 'Şablondan' quick-pick -> EventForm prefill all verified working.

minor.issue: Request body is mandatory: POSTing with NO body at all returns 422 (Field required). Spec says 'empty body' should default to the admin's own user_id. Fix: `body: RsvpTestSendBody = RsvpTestSendBody()` (or Body(default=...)). Current UI sends {} so it works in practice, but any curl/integration without a body breaks.

ui_bugs.issue: BLOCKER (fixed by tester to allow testing): function declaration was inserted inside a JSX <input ...> attribute list in BireyselEventForm (after onChange={(e)=>setShowInLb(...)}) causing 'SyntaxError: Unexpected token (3403:32)' and a total frontend compile failure. I relocated the identical component to module scope at end of file. Main agent MUST review the relocation and ensure no duplicate/leftover copy in future edits.

After saving a schedule the 'Zamanlanmış Hatırlatmalar' list does NOT refresh (rsvp-schedules-list stays absent) — the modal's onSaved does not mutate the SWR key '/rsvp-schedules?include_sent=true' owned by RsvpSchedulesList. Row only appears after a manual reload or the 60s refreshInterval. Fix: use useSWRConfig().mutate('/rsvp-schedules?include_sent=true') in RsvpScheduleModal.save (or hoist mutate).

'Şablon yüklendi: <name>' toast fires TWICE on quick-pick open. useEffect deps are [initialTemplate?.id, templates.length] with no applied-once ref guard, so any /event-templates revalidation re-applies the template (would also silently overwrite user edits). Fix: guard with a useRef(false).

No data-testid="event-form-container" wrapper as referenced in the test brief; only individual field testids (event-form-name/date/multiplier/...) exist. Add the container testid for reliable modal-open assertions.

integration_issues.issue: Works: POST test-send with {} returns 200; env has 0 push subs and 0 telegram chat ids so the warning toast 'Kullanıcının push aboneliği veya Telegram bağlantısı yok' is shown as designed. Real push/telegram delivery could NOT be verified in this environment (no subscriptions/chat ids).

issues: React DOM nesting error logged: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' (hydration warning) originating from a select's option content — pre-existing, cosmetic but pollutes console.

action_items: Review the Events.jsx TemplateQuickPickButton relocation I applied (was a compile-breaking bad insertion) — ensure future edits don't paste components inside JSX.
Mutate the '/rsvp-schedules?include_sent=true' SWR key after schedule create so the row appears without reload.
Add an applied-once ref guard to the EventForm initialTemplate useEffect (double toast / re-apply risk).
Make POST /rsvp-templates/{tid}/test-send accept a completely absent body (default RsvpTestSendBody()).
Optional: add data-testid="event-form-container" to the EventForm modal wrapper.
critical_code_review_comments: Events.jsx is ~3900 lines and Templates.jsx ~1100 — both over the 700-line guideline; the compile blocker is a direct symptom of editing such a huge file. Split into components/events/* and components/templates/*.

check_and_fire_due_schedules compares ISO strings lexicographically ({'send_at': {'$lte': now}}). This is only correct while every send_at is a UTC '+00:00' offset ISO string. A schedule written with a different offset (or 'Z') would compare wrong. Store send_at as a real BSON date instead.

make_scheduler_loop has no jitter/lock; if multiple backend workers ever run, the same schedule can fire N times (no atomic findOneAndUpdate claim). Use an atomic update_one({'id':..,'sent':{'$ne':True}}) claim before sending.

_run_send bumps send_count for scheduled fires too, which is correct, but the schedule row keeps no reference to failures beyond last_error; a fired-but-failed schedule stays sent=false forever and will retry every 60s indefinitely (no max attempts / backoff).

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the compile blocker: the v135.39 edit inserted the whole TemplateQuickPickButton function body between JSX attributes of the 'bireysel-visible-checkbox' <input> in BireyselEventForm (Events.jsx line ~3398), producing 'SyntaxError: Unexpected token (3403:32)'. CRA served the error overlay for every route, so no page (including /sablonlar) rendered — all 4 features were untestable. Fix applied: deleted the misplaced block, restored the input's attribute list, re-appended the identical component at module scope; eslint clean and app compiles.
